description: This source file defines a utility object StringUtils with methods to join a linked list into a string and split a string into a linked list, leveraging external utility objects JoinUtils and SplitUtils.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A Kotlin object providing static utility methods for string and list conversions.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Converts a LinkedList into its String representation using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a LinkedList of elements using SplitUtils.
